name: CValues
intro: CValues 是首个中文人类价值观评测基准，从安全和责任两个递进层级评估 LLM：众包人员收集十类对抗安全提示，八个领域的专业专家撰写责任提示，并同时提供人工与自动评测。
build_method: 十类安全场景中由众包人员攻击早期 ChatPLUG，八个责任领域由专业专家各写 100 题；再经人工归类、反向改写和选项换序构建自动选择题
metric: 人工：安全回答占比、责任回答专家平均分；自动：准确率及排除拒答后的准确率
task_type: 开放式问答, 安全测试, 排序
scale: 2,100 条人工评测提示 + 4,312 道自动选择题
build_method_en: Crowdworkers attack early ChatPLUG across ten safety scenarios while eight domain experts write 100 responsibility prompts each; human categorization, opposite-response rewriting, and option-order swapping produce automatic MCQs
intro_en: CValues is the first Chinese human-values benchmark to assess two ascending levels of alignment: crowdworker-collected adversarial safety prompts across ten scenarios and responsibility prompts authored by experts in eight domains, with both human and automatic evaluation.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2307.09705 Sections 2.1–2.3 and Figure 3. CValues defines two ascending Chinese-value criteria: Level 1 safety, requiring no harmful or risky response, and Level 2 responsibility, requiring positive guidance, humanistic care, and attention to social impact. For safety, the authors extend a ten-scenario taxonomy and have crowdworkers attack an early ChatPLUG instant-message chatbot; only questions that successfully trigger a safety issue are labeled by scenario and retained, yielding 1,300 prompts. For responsibility, the 100 Bottles of Poison for AI project recruits eight professional experts from domains such as environmental science, law, and psychology, each writing 100 induced questions, yielding 800 prompts. These 2,100 prompts form the human-evaluation set. Safety responses are independently labeled safe/unsafe by three specialized annotators and majority-voted, with safe-response proportion as score. Because full expert evaluation is expensive, responsibility human evaluation uses ChatPLUG-13B as a representative: three top-k candidates per prompt are judged by the originating expert, who chooses the best or neither, scores it 1–10, and may write an answer; domain means are reported. For automatic evaluation, multiple LLM responses are human-categorized into opposite value classes; ChatGPT rewrites one response if a class is missing; one response from each class is templated into a binary MCQ and the option order is swapped. The automatic set has 4,312 items—2,600 safety and 1,712 responsibility—and reports accuracy both including and excluding refusals.
